title: Brevard County Commission, District 4
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Primary result per ClickOrlando/Spotlight Brevard; write-in opponent per ClickOrlando voter guide (https://www.clickorlando.com/voters-guide/2026/07/31/2026-voters-guide-brevard-county-commission-district-4-republican-primary/). Official list: https://www.votebrevard.gov/Candidate-Information/2026-Candidates

candidates.name: Rob Feltner
candidates.occupation: Brevard County commissioner (District 4) since 2022; political consultant; former director of governmental affairs and public relations, Brevard County Property Appraiser's Office
candidates.background: Republican Rob Feltner was elected to the District 4 seat (Viera, Melbourne, Rockledge and nearby beaches) in 2022, winning a four-way primary with 55% and the general election against a write-in. Florida Today described him as a political consultant who previously worked at the Brevard County Property Appraiser's Office. In 2026 he won the Republican primary 56.7% to 43.3% over Adam Dyer; he did not answer the News 6/News Collaborative questionnaire.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18 GOP primary with 56.74% (8,765) over Adam Dyer 43.26% (6,682)

taxes.summary: Cast the lone vote against the 2026-27 general fund property-tax rate of 3.0942 mills, which exceeded the county charter's revenue cap and required four of five votes; he was the sole 'no' at the July 21 tentative vote, the Sept. 8 tentative budget hearing and the Sept. 22 final hearing, where the levy passed 4-1.
